scope: Test the modern 4x2 profile with K and B2 tiled and the eligible A tile path, and the same modern profile with tiles off, against the exact 979 Zopro and Aeglos profiles.
gate: Each candidate needs negative paired medians and at least six of eight wins per input against frozen. Tiles also compare against modern. Compare all against prepared Aeglos.
correctness: Independent Gnark verification, exact class memberships and per-lane curve results, and optional scratch denial.
